_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fs3i#1, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed a missing CLONING MATERIAL MAP mapping 'raises cannot clone material for <field> at setup'. Upstream fs3i_part_1wc_infperm.4C.yaml actually declares THREE entries, not the two the entry describes (fluid -> scatra1, structure -> scatra2, fluid -> ale). Deleting either of the two the entry mentions kills the process identically: 'terminate called after throwing an instance of std::out_of_range' and SIGABRT (shell status 134), with zero 'PROC 0 ERROR in' lines, no occurrence of the word 'cloning', no field name, no material id and no result-test section. There is nothing for a caller to grep. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::out_of_range'

_mutation.note: remove the missing-scatra2-clone pathology: keep the structure -> scatra2 entry. NOSCATRA2_CLONE_ENTRIES becomes 3 (a forbidden token), the std::out_of_range terminate vanishes and the fixture must go red.
remove the missing-ale-clone pathology: keep the fluid -> ale entry. NOALE_CLONE_ENTRIES becomes 3 (a forbidden token) and the fixture must go red.
